task.description: Implement the ISS-0669 fix per src/design/ISS-0669-pool-mutex-fix.md. Changes to src/db/pool.zig only. (1) Change Pool.mutex field from std.Io.Mutex to std.Thread.Mutex. (2) Rename all lock/unlock call sites: lockUncancelable(self.io) -> lock(), unlock(self.io) -> unlock(). (3) In acquire(): restructure so self.mutex.unlock() is called BEFORE applyRequestStorageRouting() and maybeRedirectToTenantHost() — the connection is exclusively owned by the caller after it is popped from idle_indices. (4) Handle the new error paths in acquire() if the routing SQL fails (connection must be released back or cleaned up). Note: pg.Conn.connectUrl(self.io,...) in the stale-conn reconnection block may need to remain under the lock or handle specially — refer to the design's Open Question 1 section for guidance. Commit: 'fix(pool): ISS-0669 replace Io.Mutex with Thread.Mutex, routing outside critical section (#709)'. Push to feature/WF03-ISS0669-20260812. Run lint_handoffs.py exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: no lockUncancelable(io) or unlock(io) calls remain

result.summary: Implemented ISS-0669 fix in src/db/pool.zig: (1) Added PoolMutex wrapper (std.atomic.Mutex + Thread.yield spinlock) as std.Thread.Mutex does not exist in Zig 0.16; (2) Changed Pool.mutex field to PoolMutex; (3) Restructured Pool.acquire() to call mutex.unlock() BEFORE maybeRedirectToTenantHost() and applyRequestStorageRouting(), with re-lock-pushback-unlock error paths; (4) Renamed all lockUncancelable(io)/unlock(io) call sites in release() to lock()/unlock(). zig build exits 0, no error-set issues.

issues.note: std.Thread.Mutex does not exist in Zig 0.16. Replaced with file-local PoolMutex wrapper (std.atomic.Mutex + Thread.yield spin). This is a spinlock, adequate for the pool's low-contention short critical section. A futex-based blocking mutex would be a future improvement if the pool grows larger.
